messages:
nora: FYI seeing surge of mTLS handshake failures between eu-west and ap-south since ~4987650000. Logs show `kms:AccessDenied` and `ocsp: no staple` spikes.
diego: was there a keystore RBAC change around that timestamp? we had an infra RBAC sweep earlier this week.
nora: yes, RBAC rollout rb-2026-04-02-22 modified service account bindings for keystore-controller; cloudtrail shows `UpdateRoleBinding` at 4987649900.
security-bot: ALERT: 502s up 12% for svc=proxy-eu. Top signatures: `KMS.DecryptAccessDenied`, `tls: unknown CA`, `ocsp: request timed out`.
eva: quick triage: check keystore-controller logs -> `unwrap error: AccessDenied` repeatedly, then rotator fails to publish new cert chain to proxies.
ops-jen: can we do a scoped rolebinding revert for keystore-controller to restore kms:Decrypt? prefer not to revert whole RBAC policy.
diego: agreed. patch we can apply: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata: name: keystore-controller-decrypt
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: keystore-controller
  namespace: infra
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: kms-decrypt
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF`
security-bot: NOTE: OCSP responder in eu-west had p95 ~600ms in the interval (telemetry link). Slow OCSP + missing intermediate in some proxy nodes likely caused hard failures.
nora: proxies report `unknown CA` after rotator wrote chain with new intermediate CN=Redwood-Int-v2. Some nodes still have old CA bundle. DaemonSet rolling update missed zone eu-west-1c.
eva: mitigation plan: 1) apply scoped RBAC rollback for keystore-controller 2) restart keystore-controller pods to pick up rolebinding 3) force-roll proxy DaemonSet in eu-west to update CA bundles 4) toggle OCSP soft-fail in proxy configmap as temporary measure.
ops-jen: applying scoped rollback to staging now. will validate KMS decrypt in logs.
diego: can someone run `auditbot query --since 4h --kind=RoleBinding --actor=deploy/infra-config` to capture the RBAC mutation id? we need that for the postmortem.
ops-jen: staging apply succeeded. smoke OK. about to apply to prod-eu with `kubectl apply -f keystore-rollback.yaml -n infra`
security-bot: DEPLOYMENT: keystore rolebinding rollback applied to prod-eu by ops-jen at ts 4987650020.
nora: seeing `kms:Decrypt` successes now. rotator resumed publishing chain and proxies accepted updated cert on most nodes.
eva: pushed temp proxy config with `ocsp.strict=false` and `ocsp_timeout_ms=700` in configmap `proxy-tls-eu` to reduce hard aborts while we finish rollouts.
diego: follow-ups: - add RBAC change CI gate for RoleBindings affecting keystore-controller - add DaemonSet rollout verification across zones (hook in deploy pipeline) - add rotator integration test that validates full chain distribution including intermediates - OCSP latency alert at p95>300ms.
ops-jen: creating tickets and linking incident INC-2026-0483. Keeping thread open 45m to monitor.
security-bot: REMINDER: include CloudTrail and Auditbot outputs in the postmortem and tag infra-config deploy owner.
eva: will also add a fallback in keystore-controller: if `Decrypt` returns AccessDenied or InvalidCiphertext, surface clear telemetry and try configured replica alias after short backoff.
ops-jen: prod-eu DaemonSet forced-roll completed; all nodes show new CA bundle. ingress metrics normalized.
nora: closing the immediate mitigation. moving to root-cause analysis and action tracking. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
